title: अष्टसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 78 · Seventh day: Virata and Drona's son

summary.en: Trigarta Susharman retreats and Bhishma moves swiftly against Arjuna's side. Virata and Ashvatthaman fight a long duel, and Satyaki and Bhima kill many Kaurava warriors.
summary.kn: ತ್ರಿಗರ್ತ ಸುಶರ್ಮ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಕಡೆಗೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಿರಾಟ ಮತ್ತು ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ ದೀರ್ಘ ದ್ವಂದ್ವ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ, ಭೀಮರು ಅನೇಕ ಕೌರವ ಯೋಧರನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: त्रिगर्त सुशर्मा पीछे हटता है और भीष्म तेजी से अर्जुन की ओर बढ़ते हैं। विराट और अश्वत्थामा का लम्बा द्वन्द्व होता है, और सात्यकि और भीम बहुत से कौरव योद्धाओं को मारते हैं।
summary.te: త్రిగర్త సుశర్మ వెనక్కి తగ్గుతాడు; భీష్ముడు అర్జునుని వైపు వేగంగా వెళతాడు. విరాటుడు, అశ్వత్థామ చాలాసేపు ద్వంద్వయుద్ధం చేస్తారు; సాత్యకి, భీముడు అనేక కౌరవ యోధులను చంపుతారు.
summary.ta: திரிகர்த்த சுசர்மன் பின்வாங்க, பீஷ்மர் வேகமாக அர்ஜுனன் பக்கம் செல்கிறார். விராடனும் அஸ்வத்தாமனும் நீண்ட தனிப்போர் புரிகின்றனர்; சாத்யகியும் பீமனும் பல கௌரவ வீரரைக் கொல்கின்றனர்.
summary.ml: ത്രിഗർത്തനായ സുശർമാവ് പിൻവാങ്ങുന്നു; ഭീഷ്മർ വേഗത്തിൽ അർജുനന്റെ പക്ഷത്തേക്ക് നീങ്ങുന്നു. വിരാടനും അശ്വത്ഥാമാവും നീണ്ട ദ്വന്ദ്വയുദ്ധം നടത്തുന്നു; സാത്യകിയും ഭീമനും നിരവധി കൗരവ യോദ്ധാക്കളെ വധിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.78; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तथा प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे निवृत्ते च सुशर्मणि ।
प्रभग्नेषु च वीरेषु पाण्डवेन महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: As the battle went on, Susharman turned back and the heroes were scattered by the great-souled son of Pandu.

verses.text:
क्षुभ्यमाणे बले तूर्णं सागरप्रतिमे तव ।
प्रत्युद्याते च गाङ्गेये त्वरितं विजयं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Your army, churned like an ocean, was in turmoil, and the son of Ganga rushed swiftly to bring victory.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनो राजन्रणे पार्थस्य विक्रमम् ।
त्वरमाणः समभ्येत्य सर्वांस्तानब्रवीन्नृपान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Partha's prowess in the battle, O king, Duryodhana came up in haste and addressed all those kings.

verses.text:
तेषां च प्रमुखे शूरं सुशर्माणं महाबलम् ।
मध्ये सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य भृशं संहर्षयन्वचः ॥

meaning.en: Before them, in the midst of all the army, he spoke to the mighty hero Susharman, to hearten them greatly.

verses.text:
एष भीष्मः शांतनवो योद्धुकामो धनंजयम् ।
सर्वात्मना कुरुश्रेष्ठस्त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Here is Bhishma, son of Shantanu, best of the Kurus, wanting to fight Dhananjaya, with his whole self and careless of his own life.

verses.text:
तं प्रयान्तं परानीकं सर्वसैन्येन भारतम् ।
संयत्ताः समरे सर्वे पालयध्वं पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: As he goes against the enemy army with the whole of his forces, all of you be ready in the battle and protect the grandfather.

verses.text:
बाढमित्येवमुक्त्वा तु तान्यनीकानि सर्वशः ।
नरेन्द्राणां महाराज समाजग्मुः पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it," the armies of those kings gathered from every side around the grandfather, O great king.

verses.text:
ततः प्रयातः सहसा भीष्मः शांतनवोऽर्जुनम् ।
रणे भारतमायान्तमाससाद महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhishma, son of Shantanu, suddenly advanced and met the mighty Arjuna, the Bharata, coming at him in battle.

verses.text:
महाश्वेताश्वयुक्तेन भीमवानरकेतुना ।
महता मेघनादेन रथेनाति विराजत ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna shone brilliantly on his great chariot, yoked with huge white horses, with the fearsome monkey on its banner and a roar like a great cloud.

verses.text:
समरे सर्वसैन्यानामुपयातं धनंजयम् ।
अभवत्तुमुलो नादो भयाद्दृष्ट्वा किरीटिनम् ॥

meaning.en: When Dhananjaya, the Diadem-wearer, advanced against all the armies, a tumult of cries rose from the fear at seeing him.

verses.text:
अभीशुहस्तं कृष्णं च दृष्ट्वादित्यमिवापरम् ।
मध्यंदिनगतं संख्ये न शेकुः प्रतिवीक्षितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Krishna with the reins in his hands, bright as a second sun at midday, they could not look at him in the battle.

verses.text:
तथा शांतनवं भीष्मं श्वेताश्वं श्वेतकार्मुकम् ।
न शेकुः पाण्डवा द्रष्टुं श्वेतग्रहमिवोदितम् ॥

meaning.en: And the Pandavas could not look at Bhishma, son of Shantanu, with his white horses and white bow, as if at a risen white planet.

verses.text:
स सर्वतः परिवृतस्त्रिगर्तैः सुमहात्मभिः ।
भ्रातृभिस्तव पुत्रैश्च तथान्यैश्च महारथैः ॥

meaning.en: He was surrounded on all sides by the Trigartas, those great-souled men, and by your sons, his brothers, and other great chariot-warriors.

verses.text:
भारद्वाजस्तु समरे मत्स्यं विव्याध पत्रिणा ।
ध्वजं चास्य शरेणाजौ धनुश्चैकेन चिच्छिदे ॥

meaning.en: Drona, son of Bharadvaja, pierced the Matsya king Virata with an arrow in the battle, cut his banner with one arrow and his bow with another.

verses.text:
तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं विराटो वाहिनीपतिः ।
अन्यदादत्त वेगेन धनुर्भारसहं दृढम् ।
शरांश्चाशीविषाकाराञ्ज्वलितान्पन्नगानिव ॥

meaning.en: Throwing aside that cut bow, Virata, the army's leader, quickly took another strong bow that could bear the strain, and arrows like blazing snakes, like venomous serpents.

verses.text:
द्रोणं त्रिभिः प्रविव्याध चतुर्भिश्चास्य वाजिनः ।
ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध सारथिं चास्य पञ्चभिः ।
धनुरेकेषुणाविध्यत्तत्राक्रुध्यद्द्विजर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: He struck Drona with three arrows and his horses with four, his banner with one and his charioteer with five, and his bow with one. Then the best of brahmins grew angry.

verses.text:
तस्य द्रोणोऽवधीदश्वाञ्शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
अष्टाभिर्भरतश्रेष्ठ सूतमेकेन पत्रिणा ॥

meaning.en: Drona killed Virata's horses with eight arrows with bent joints, best of Bharatas, and his charioteer with one feathered arrow.

verses.text:
स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य स्यन्दनाद्धतसारथिः ।
आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं शङ्खस्य रथिनां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Virata, with his horses and charioteer killed, leapt from his chariot and quickly climbed onto the chariot of Shankha, the best of charioteers.

verses.text:
ततस्तु तौ पितापुत्रौ भारद्वाजं रथे स्थितौ ।
महता शरवर्षेण वारयामासतुर्बलात् ॥

meaning.en: Then father and son, standing on one chariot, strongly held back Drona, son of Bharadvaja, with a great shower of arrows.

verses.text:
भारद्वाजस्ततः क्रुद्धः शरमाशीविषोपमम् ।
चिक्षेप समरे तूर्णं शङ्खं प्रति जनेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona in anger quickly hurled at Shankha an arrow like a venomous snake, O lord of men.

verses.text:
स तस्य हृदयं भित्त्वा पीत्वा शोणितमाहवे ।
जगाम धरणिं बाणो लोहितार्द्रीकृतच्छविः ॥

meaning.en: That arrow pierced Shankha's heart, drank his blood in the battle, and went into the earth, its surface wet with blood.

verses.text:
स पपात रथात्तूर्णं भारद्वाजशराहतः ।
धनुस्त्यक्त्वा शरांश्चैव पितुरेव समीपतः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by Drona's arrow, Shankha fell quickly from the chariot, dropping his bow and arrows right beside his father.

verses.text:
हतं स्वमात्मजं दृष्ट्वा विराटः प्राद्रवद्भयात् ।
उत्सृज्य समरे द्रोणं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his own son killed, Virata fled in fear, leaving Drona in the battle as if he were Death with open jaws.

verses.text:
भारद्वाजस्ततस्तूर्णं पाण्डवानां महाचमूम् ।
दारयामास समरे शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona quickly tore apart the great Pandava army in the battle, by hundreds and by thousands.

verses.text:
शिखण्ड्यपि महाराज द्रौणिमासाद्य संयुगे ।
आजघान भ्रुवोर्मध्ये नाराचैस्त्रिभिराशुगैः ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi, O great king, meeting Drona's son in the fight, struck him between the brows with three swift iron arrows.

verses.text:
स बभौ नरशार्दूलो ललाटे संस्थितैस्त्रिभिः ।
शिखरैः काञ्चनमयैर्मेरुस्त्रिभिरिवोच्छ्रितैः ॥

meaning.en: With those three stuck in his forehead, that tiger among men shone like Meru with three golden peaks raised high.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा ततः क्रुद्धो निमेषार्धाच्छिखण्डिनः ।
सूतं ध्वजमथो राजंस्तुरगानायुधं तथा ।
शरैर्बहुभिरुद्दिश्य पातयामास संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthama, angry, in half a moment brought down Shikhandi's charioteer, banner, horses and weapon in the battle with many arrows aimed at them.

verses.text:
स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथाद्वै रथिनां वरः ।
खड्गमादाय निशितं विमलं च शरावरम् ।
श्येनवद्व्यचरत्क्रुद्धः शिखण्डी शत्रुतापनः ॥

meaning.en: The best of charioteers leapt from his horseless chariot, took a sharp sword and a bright shield, and ranged about like a hawk, enraged, Shikhandi the tormentor of enemies.

verses.text:
सखड्गस्य महाराज चरतस्तस्य संयुगे ।
नान्तरं ददृशे द्रौणिस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: As he moved in the battle with sword in hand, O great king, Drona's son could find no opening in him, and it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
ततः शरसहस्राणि बहूनि भरतर्षभ ।
प्रेषयामास समरे द्रौणिः परमकोपनः ॥

meaning.en: Then, O best of Bharatas, Drona's son, in the greatest anger, sent many thousands of arrows in the battle.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं समरे शरवृष्टिं सुदारुणाम् ।
असिना तीक्ष्णधारेण चिच्छेद बलिनां वरः ॥

meaning.en: That terrible rain of arrows coming at him, the best of the mighty cut down with his sharp-edged sword.

verses.text:
ततोऽस्य विमलं द्रौणिः शतचन्द्रं मनोरमम् ।
चर्माच्छिनदसिं चास्य खण्डयामास संयुगे ।
शितैः सुबहुशो राजंस्तं च विव्याध पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son cut his lovely bright shield, marked with a hundred moons, and broke his sword in the battle, and pierced Shikhandi with many sharp feathered arrows, O king.

verses.text:
शिखण्डी तु ततः खड्गं खण्डितं तेन सायकैः ।
आविध्य व्यसृजत्तूर्णं ज्वलन्तमिव पन्नगम् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi then whirled the sword, which had been broken by those arrows, and flung it quickly, like a blazing snake.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं सहसा कालानलसमप्रभम् ।
चिच्छेद समरे द्रौणिर्दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम् ।
शिखण्डिनं च विव्याध शरैर्बहुभिरायसैः ॥

meaning.en: As it came suddenly, radiant as the fire at the end of time, Drona's son cut it down in the battle, showing his quick hands, and struck Shikhandi with many iron arrows.

verses.text:
शिखण्डी तु भृशं राजंस्ताड्यमानः शितैः शरैः ।
आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं माधवस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi, O king, hard struck by those sharp arrows, quickly climbed onto the chariot of the great-souled Satyaki.

verses.text:
सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो राक्षसं क्रूरमाहवे ।
अलम्बुसं शरैर्घोरैर्विव्याध बलिनं बली ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki, the strong, in anger pierced the mighty, cruel rakshasa Alambusa with terrible arrows in the battle.

verses.text:
राक्षसेन्द्रस्ततस्तस्य धनुश्चिच्छेद भारत ।
अर्धचन्द्रेण समरे तं च विव्याध सायकैः ।
मायां च राक्षसीं कृत्वा शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: The rakshasa chief then cut Satyaki's bow, O Bharata, with a crescent-headed arrow and struck him with arrows, and creating rakshasa illusion, covered him with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम शैनेयस्य पराक्रमम् ।
नासंभ्रमद्यत्समरे वध्यमानः शितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: There we saw the marvelous prowess of Satyaki, the Shini grandson: he did not lose composure, though struck in the battle by sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ऐन्द्रमस्त्रं च वार्ष्णेयो योजयामास भारत ।
विजयाद्यदनुप्राप्तं माधवेन यशस्विना ॥

meaning.en: The Vrishni, O Bharata, fitted the weapon of Indra that the glorious Satyaki had received from Vijaya.

verses.text:
तदस्त्रं भस्मसात्कृत्वा मायां तां राक्षसीं तदा ।
अलम्बुसं शरैर्घोरैरभ्याकिरत सर्वशः ।
पर्वतं वारिधाराभिः प्रावृषीव बलाहकः ॥

meaning.en: Burning up that weapon and the rakshasa's illusion to ashes, he covered Alambusa on all sides with terrible arrows, as a cloud in the rains covers a mountain with streams of water.

verses.text:
तत्तथा पीडितं तेन माधवेन महात्मना ।
प्रदुद्राव भयाद्रक्षो हित्वा सात्यकिमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Hard pressed by great-souled Satyaki, the rakshasa fled in fear, abandoning him in the battle.

verses.text:
तमजेयं राक्षसेन्द्रं संख्ये मघवता अपि ।
शैनेयः प्राणदज्जित्वा योधानां तव पश्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: That chief of rakshasas, whom even Indra could not conquer in battle, Satyaki defeated and let go with his life, as your warriors looked on.

verses.text:
न्यहनत्तावकांश्चापि सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः ।
निशितैर्बहुभिर्बाणैस्तेऽद्रवन्त भयार्दिताः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, of true prowess, also struck down your men with many sharp arrows, and they fled, pained with fear.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु द्रुपदस्यात्मजो बली ।
धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज तव पुत्रं जनेश्वरम् ।
छादयामास समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: Just then Dhrishtadyumna, the mighty son of Drupada, O great king, covered your son, the lord of men, with bent-jointed arrows in the battle.

verses.text:
संछाद्यमानो विशिखैर्धृष्टद्युम्नेन भारत ।
विव्यथे न च राजेन्द्र तव पुत्रो जनेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Though covered with arrows by Dhrishtadyumna, O Bharata, your son the king of kings did not flinch.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नं च समरे तूर्णं विव्याध सायकैः ।
षष्ट्या च त्रिंशता चैव तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: He quickly struck Dhrishtadyumna in the battle with sixty and then thirty arrows, and it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
तस्य सेनापतिः क्रुद्धो धनुश्चिच्छेद मारिष ।
हयांश्च चतुरः शीघ्रं निजघान महारथः ।
शरैश्चैनं सुनिशितैः क्षिप्रं विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥

meaning.en: The enraged commander cut his bow, O revered one, and that great chariot-warrior swiftly killed his four horses and quickly struck him with seven very sharp arrows.

verses.text:
स हताश्वान्महाबाहुरवप्लुत्य रथाद्बली ।
पदातिरसिमुद्यम्य प्राद्रवत्पार्षतं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: The strong, long-armed Duryodhana leapt from his horseless chariot and, on foot, raised his sword and rushed at Prishata's son.

verses.text:
शकुनिस्तं समभ्येत्य राजगृद्धी महाबलः ।
राजानं सर्वलोकस्य रथमारोपयत्स्वकम् ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni, the mighty, eager to save the king, came up and lifted the king of all the world onto his own chariot.

verses.text:
ततो नृपं पराजित्य पार्षतः परवीरहा ।
न्यहनत्तावकं सैन्यं वज्रपाणिरिवासुरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Dhrishtadyumna, the slayer of enemy heroes, having beaten the king, struck down your army like the thunderbolt-wielder striking the demons.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा रणे भीमं शरैरार्छन्महारथम् ।
प्रच्छादयामास च तं महामेघो रविं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Kritavarman covered the great chariot-warrior Bhima with arrows in the battle, hiding him as a great cloud hides the sun.

verses.text:
ततः प्रहस्य समरे भीमसेनः परंतपः ।
प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धः सायकान्कृतवर्मणे ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhimasena, the tormentor of foes, smiled in the battle, and enraged, sent arrows at Kritavarman.

verses.text:
तैरर्द्यमानोऽतिरथः सात्वतः शस्त्रकोविदः ।
नाकम्पत महाराज भीमं चार्छच्छितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by them, that great chariot-warrior of the Satvatas, skilled in weapons, did not tremble, O great king, and struck Bhima with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
सारथिं पातयामास ध्वजं च सुपरिष्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Mighty Bhimasena killed his four horses, and brought down his charioteer and his well-adorned banner.

verses.text:
शरैर्बहुविधैश्चैनमाचिनोत्परवीरहा ।
शकलीकृतसर्वाङ्गः श्वाविद्वत्समदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: The slayer of enemy heroes heaped him with many kinds of arrows, and with his whole body shattered Kritavarman looked like a porcupine.

verses.text:
हताश्वात्तु रथात्तूर्णं वृषकस्य रथं ययौ ।
स्यालस्य ते महाराज तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Having lost his horses, he quickly went from his chariot to the chariot of Vrishaka, your son's maternal uncle, as your son looked on, O great king.

verses.text:
भीमसेनोऽपि संक्रुद्धस्तव सैन्यमुपाद्रवत् ।
निजघान च संक्रुद्धो दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena in anger charged your army and struck it down in fury like Death with staff in hand.
